headline: 超英与续作霸榜，今日零新片
headlineEn: Superheroes and sequels top charts, zero releases today
summary: 今日（2026-08-18）无新片上映，本周共有3部新片。热度榜被《绿灯军团》《奥德赛》《玩具总动员5》等大片占据，超级英雄与续集IP表现强势；目前暂无值得关注的新档期消息。
summaryEn: Today (2026-08-18) sees no new releases, with 3 new movies total this week. Trending is dominated by Green Lantern Corps, The Odyssey, Toy Story 5 and other big titles; superheroes and sequel IPs are strong. No notable upcoming release dates are currently announced.

industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops real-time trending

industryHighlights.text: 后续暂无值得关注的新片定档
